query.rawSql: SELECT id::text AS __value, name AS __text FROM farms ORDER BY name
SELECT id::text AS __value, name AS __text FROM fields WHERE (farm_id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote})) ORDER BY name
SELECT d.id::text AS __value, d.type::text || ' #' || d.id::text AS __text FROM devices d WHERE (d.field_id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote})) ORDER BY d.type, d.id
SELECT DISTINCT s.type::text AS __value, s.type::text AS __text FROM sensors s JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id WHERE (d.id::text IN (${device_id:singlequote})) ORDER BY __text

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  sum(CASE WHEN last_seen >= now() - interval '10 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online,
  sum(CASE WHEN last_seen < now() - interval '10 minutes' OR last_seen IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline,
  count(*) AS total
FROM (
  SELECT d.id, max(sr.timestamp) AS last_seen
  FROM devices d
  JOIN fields f ON f.id = d.field_id
  LEFT JOIN sensors s ON s.device_id = d.id
  LEFT JOIN sensor_readings sr ON sr.sensor_id = s.id
  WHERE (d.field_id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote})) AND (f.farm_id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote}))
  GROUP BY d.id
) t

SELECT d.id::text AS device_id, d.type::text || ' #' || d.id::text AS device_name, ST_Y(d.location) AS lat, ST_X(d.location) AS lon, max(sr.timestamp) AS last_seen, avg(sr.value) FILTER (WHERE s.type='temperature') AS last_temp
FROM devices d
JOIN fields f ON f.id = d.field_id
LEFT JOIN sensors s ON s.device_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN sensor_readings sr ON sr.sensor_id = s.id
WHERE (d.field_id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote})) AND (f.farm_id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote})) AND (d.id::text IN (${device_id:singlequote})) AND d.location IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.id, d.type, d.location
LIMIT 1000

SELECT id::text AS farm_id, name AS farm_name, ST_Y(location) AS lat, ST_X(location) AS lon
FROM farms
WHERE id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote}) AND location IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.id::text AS field_id, f.name AS field_name, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(f.geometry)) AS lat, ST_X(ST_Centroid(f.geometry)) AS lon
FROM fields f
WHERE (f.id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote})) AND (f.farm_id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote})) AND f.geometry IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_trunc('minute', sr.timestamp) AS time, d.type::text || ' / ' || s.id::text AS metric, avg(sr.value)::double precision AS value
FROM sensor_readings sr
JOIN sensors s ON s.id = sr.sensor_id
JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id
JOIN fields f ON f.id = d.field_id
JOIN farms fm ON fm.id = f.farm_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.timestamp)
  AND (fm.id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote}))
  AND (f.id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote}))
  AND (d.id::text IN (${device_id:singlequote}))
  AND (s.type::text IN (${sensor_type:singlequote}))
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time

SELECT sr.timestamp, fm.name AS farm, f.name AS field, d.type::text || ' #' || d.id::text AS device, s.id AS sensor_id, s.type AS sensor_type, sr.value, s.unit
FROM sensor_readings sr
JOIN sensors s ON s.id = sr.sensor_id
JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id
JOIN fields f ON f.id = d.field_id
JOIN farms fm ON fm.id = f.farm_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(sr.timestamp)
  AND (fm.id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote}))
  AND (f.id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote}))
  AND (d.id::text IN (${device_id:singlequote}))
  AND (s.type::text IN (${sensor_type:singlequote}))
ORDER BY sr.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Device diagnostics
panels.description: Latest diagnostics each device reported in the selected time range (device_telemetry). Empty rows: no SenML diagnostics in the range (silent, or still on the legacy JSON payload).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device AS "Device", last_telemetry AS "Last telemetry", rssi AS "RSSI (dBm)",
       boots AS "Boots",
       NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
         CASE WHEN reset & 1    > 0 THEN 'PIN' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 2    > 0 THEN 'SOFTWARE' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 4    > 0 THEN 'BROWNOUT' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 8    > 0 THEN 'POWER-ON' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 16   > 0 THEN 'WATCHDOG' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 32   > 0 THEN 'DEBUG' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 128  > 0 THEN 'LOW-POWER WAKE' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 256  > 0 THEN 'CPU LOCKUP' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 4096 > 0 THEN 'HARDWARE' END,
         CASE WHEN reset & 8192 > 0 THEN 'USER' END), '') AS "Last reset",
       seq AS "Last seq",
       cfg AS "Config",
       fs_pct AS "FS used (%)",
       fs_errors AS "FS errors",
       last_reformat AS "Last FS reformat"
FROM (
  -- Latest value of each diagnostic in the time range (device_telemetry, Plano_Telemetria.md D5).
  -- LEFT JOIN keeps devices that sent nothing, so silent ones show up as empty rows.
  SELECT d.id, d.type::text || ' #' || d.id::text AS device,
         max(t.timestamp) AS last_telemetry,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'rssi')::numeric ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'rssi'))[1] AS rssi,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'boot_count')::bigint ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'boot_count'))[1] AS boots,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'reset_reason')::bigint ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'reset_reason'))[1] AS reset,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'seq')::bigint ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'seq'))[1] AS seq,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'cfg_version')::bigint ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'cfg_version'))[1] AS cfg,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'fs_used_pct')::numeric ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'fs_used_pct'))[1] AS fs_pct,
         (array_agg((t.data->>'fs_errors')::bigint ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC)
            FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'fs_errors'))[1] AS fs_errors,
         max(t.timestamp) FILTER (WHERE t.data ? 'fs_reformat') AS last_reformat
  FROM devices d
  JOIN fields f ON f.id = d.field_id
  LEFT JOIN device_telemetry t ON t.device_id = d.id AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
  WHERE (f.farm_id::text IN (${farm_id:singlequote}))
    AND (f.id::text IN (${field_id:singlequote}))
    AND (d.id::text IN (${device_id:singlequote}))
  GROUP BY d.id, d.type
) diag
ORDER BY id
